newsitem.title: FRANCE: Euris says Casino stake not for sale - paper.
newsitem.headline: Euris says Casino stake not for sale - paper.

text.p: Holding group Euris chairman Jean-Charles Naouri said in a newspaper interview that Euris's 33 percent stake in retailer Casino was not for sale but he did not rule out a partnership with Promodes.

Naouri told the newspaper La Tribune Casino had attained a "critical mass" of more than 100 billion francs of sales and was in a position to decide whether it wanted to develop alone or with partners.
Asked about recurring rumours of a Casino-Promodes linkup, Naouri said: "It's certainly one of the possible partnerships".
The other option is internal growth, which may include acquiring assets "at a rhythm of five to ten billion francs of turnover per year".
